summary: A middleware change removes the tenant ownership check before returning account data.
A new dependency deserializes user uploads into polymorphic runtime types.
A response field is renamed while callers and serialization contracts remain unchanged.
A public configuration key and default change across the CLI and GitHub Action.
A database lookup moved inside a loop over every result row.
A blocking filesystem traversal now runs directly on the async request executor.
A required CLI flag is renamed but the README command examples still use the old flag.
A new mandatory setup value is introduced without updating the existing setup guide.
A private helper is renamed without changing behavior or public contracts.
Existing parser behavior receives additional test coverage only.
A CLI default changes and the README is updated correctly in the same pull request.
Repository instructions for coding agents change without product or developer documentation changes.
